supersedes: Implementation prerequisite sentence in diagnostic-scope.json is satisfied by this fixed design; executable source and full source/data/model SHA search-plan freeze remain required before formal training.
gate: head_probes.verified_completion; selection.promoted must be strictly False; no head-confirmation OUT. Repeat during resume and completion. Do not create formal fusion OUT or read feature bank before gate.
delta: 4*tanh(g(h)/4); final weight+bias zero-initialized; correction input=head512 only; five base logits never correction inputs.
output: Add delta to system raw logit only. Other four raw logits unchanged; non-system conditional distribution invariant, but absolute probabilities/argmax/CoT recall may change.
scalers: Head512 uses completed head-probes scaler,578090densefit-only. Frozen dense128 retains exact embedded original8640 scaler.

base_cache.binding: All rows/sample_ix/cache_ix, both feature SHA, both scaler SHA, model/source/completion SHA. Reject missing/truncated/nonfinite/hash drift on any resume.

record: mean and max difference to frozen dense saved p
same validation helper retuned threshold and metrics
zero_control.claim: Mathematical zero-offset identity; actual floating arithmetic compared with tolerance, never claim unverified bit identity.

training.worker_gpu: one GPU per worker after baseline cache is complete
training.supervision: parent PID lease, terminate/wait/kill/reap on failure

controls: delta0-cache retuned via same validation helper
selection.guards_against_each_control: original four profile systemF1 loss<=.02 and five-wayaccuracy loss<=.01; long-full and tailF1 nondecrease; every five profile systemFPR<=.05; tolerance1e-12
selection.promotion: mean5profileF1 > max(two controls)+1e-12; rank highest mean among dual-guard eligible; else retain diagnostic only

portable: Consumes raw8640 plus raw512 at current token; frozen baseline SHA + embedded scaler, independently saved head correction; full validation zero-offset and nonzero portable checks required.
limitations: Two frozen feature banks share exact rows but their LM extraction batches differ. Do not claim isolated causal head effect.
Other four classes relative ordering cannot change; cannot repair CoT/tool internal argmax confusion.
Development validation reused; any accepted model still needs new independent confirmation.
